PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces vanilla's twitchy first-person weapons with CoD / Battlefield ADS sensitivity and variable per-weapon zoom
PluginData.Description:
Aim-down-sights tuning for hand weapons, CoD / Battlefield style.
- FOV-based sensitivity: replaces vanilla's flat 0.6x ironsight look speed with monitor distance matching (coefficient 1.33, the CoD / Battlefield default), so aim feels the same at any zoom. - Per-weapon zoom: set the magnification of every hand weapon, modded guns included. Vanilla presets: pistols 1.5x, launchers 1.75x, MR-8P 3x, others 2x. - Smooth zoom: eased zoom in and out (0.15 s).
Keys: none of its own. Aim with your usual key; hold or toggle aim is the vanilla option in Options > Game. Settings: coefficient 0 to 2, ADS multiplier, zoom time, default zoom 1 to 6x, one row per weapon.
Client-side only, works on any server. Only your view and mouse speed change. Compatible with Polar's PVP Lean, Scrollable FOV and Zoom (their zoom stacks on top). Known issues: modded guns join the list once a world with them is loaded.
Docs and bug reports: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsADSImprovements
